primary_references.title: Le Figaro (Paris, 1826) — BnF
primary_references.note: Primary catalogue: publication 1826–1834. Title only, not a copy of a modern logo or issue. Some publications had formats different from the stylized folded broadsheet.

primary_references.title: Le Constitutionnel (1815) — BnF
primary_references.note: Primary catalogue search result verifies 1815–1817 title. Direct open failed; no exact scan was copied.

primary_references.title: National Intelligencer — Library of Congress
primary_references.note: Catalogue gives foundation in 1800 and title change in 1810 to National Intelligencer. Use publication name, not reproduced articles.

primary_references.title: 京報 — Taiwan Ministry of Education dictionary
primary_references.note: Official dictionary identifies Qing-era Beijing print publication carrying court news, not a modern independent mass-market daily. Traditional spelling 京報.

primary_references.title: 京報 rare-book catalogue — National Central Library
primary_references.note: Catalogue search result describes 1904–1905 copies; evidence of name and print practice, NOT an early-19th-century dated physical specimen.
